data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month. If all 25 follow it, everyone earns $10,000, 250 tons remain, and stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That supports the same income every month without collapse risk. I intend to request 10 tons and ask everyone to adopt this cap; we can review revealed catches afterward.

I propose 10 tons each this month and a standing 10-ton cap when stock is 500. Total catch of 250 leaves 250, guaranteeing full replenishment under either outcome. That yields $10,000 each month indefinitely if everyone cooperates. Catches are revealed afterward, so we can review compliance and coordinate future caps. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support.

I propose 10 tons each this month: total catch 250, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this yields $10,000 per person monthly without exhausting the lake. I intend to request 10 and encourage everyone to do the same. If stock is ever below 500, let's each request at most floor(stock/50), preserving at least half for recovery.
